description: Find institutions in INSPIRE-HEP (universities, departments, laboratories) by name words, an exact recorded name, or recid, for the recid that affid:N takes. Free text (University of Washington, Tokyo) returns candidates in INSPIRE's order, not by size: a university's papers often sit under department records whose parent is its "(main)" record, so pick from each record's hierarchy, paper count, and related records, and page on before concluding a unit is absent. legacy_ICN:"NAME" matches one recorded name exactly and case-sensitively (legacy_ICN:"Tokyo U."), the form cern_inspire_get_paper lists in authors[].affiliations; digits alone look up a recid. Each record carries that recorded name (legacyIcn, which aff NAME matches), hierarchy, institution types, cities, country codes, INSPIRE's paper count, parent, successor, and predecessor links, inactive status, and a literatureQuery (affid:N) for cern_inspire_search_literature or cern_inspire_get_citation_summary. affid:N matches one record; join several with or. Returns one page of records; request the next with page and the same limit. Only the first 10,000 results of a query are reachable.

limit.description: Institutions per page (positive integer, default 25; above 25 uses 25).

page.description: Page number, starting at 1. page × effective limit (after clamping) may not exceed 10,000.

query.description: Institution name words (University of Washington, Tokyo); one exact recorded name as legacy_ICN:"NAME" (case-sensitive, e.g. legacy_ICN:"Tokyo U."; legacy_ICN clauses joined with or match nothing); or an institution recid (digits only).

name: cern_inspire_search_institutions

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `beyond_result_window`: page × effective limit (after clamping) exceeds the 10,000 results INSPIRE serves for one query. `invalid_query`: INSPIRE answered 400 to a parameter value it refuses. `inspire_rate_limited`: INSPIRE returned 429 after the pacer and retries. `pacer_shed`: The server's outbound INSPIRE queue could not start the request within the call's remaining budget. `upstream_unreadable`: The INSPIRE body exceeded the byte ceiling, was HTML where JSON was expected, or was invalid JSON. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

hasMore.description: True when INSPIRE has a further page of results.

institutions.description: The institution records on this page, in INSPIRE order.

cities.description: Cities across the record's addresses, primary address first.

countryCodes.description: Country codes across the record's addresses, primary address first.

hierarchy.description: The unit this record represents, then each parent, most specific first (a department, then its university).

items.description: One level: a name, an acronym, or both.

inactive.description: True when INSPIRE marks the institution as no longer active; omitted when INSPIRE records nothing.

institutionTypes.description: Institution types (University, Research Center, Company, Other).

legacyIcn.description: The institution name INSPIRE records on papers (e.g. Tokyo U.): the name paper affiliations carry and aff NAME matches; legacy_ICN:"NAME" as the query finds this record exactly. Absent when not recorded.

literatureQuery.description: affid:N, selecting the papers linked to this record; pass to cern_inspire_search_literature, or as query to cern_inspire_get_citation_summary. It matches this record only: join a department's and its parent's with or (affid:903338 or affid:945165).

numberOfPapers.description: INSPIRE's stored paper count; it can differ from the number of records literatureQuery matches.

relatedRecords.description: Linked institution records: parents, successors, and predecessors.

recid.description: INSPIRE institution record ID of the related record.

relation.description: parent: the related record is this one's parent institution (a department's university); successor: this institution has become the related one; predecessor: the related one has become this institution. Absent when INSPIRE records none of these.

limit.description: The effective limit after clamping: institutions per page.

nextPage.description: The page number to request next, with the same limit, when one exists within the 10,000-result window.

notice.description: Guidance on an empty or paged result.

shown.description: Number of records on this page.

totalCount.description: Total institution records the query matched.

truncated.description: True when more results exist beyond this page.

title: Search INSPIRE institutions
